title: Review Dashboard information architecture and operator usability
scope: Audit the current Dashboard from solo, small-team, and enterprise operator perspectives; produce an evidence-backed prioritized review and decision agenda before authorizing any redesign.
acceptance_criteria: The review distinguishes verified usability findings from preferences and unimplemented feature ideas.
The inventory covers operational priority, Work Items and Agents, alert actionability, usage and model evidence, responsive layout, accessibility, private-viewer context, and progressive disclosure.
A proposed information hierarchy and measurable validation plan are ready for owner discussion before Build.
No Dashboard code change, remote command expansion, release, publication, or open-source preparation occurs in the review slice.
overlap_resolution: WI-0029 and WI-0030 define the local Agent Command surface; WI-0043 may review its discoverability but cannot change command authority or code without a later approved Build slice.
WI-0033 remains in Spec; WI-0043 is read-only and any later Dashboard provider-trust proposal must reconcile with WI-0033 before Build.
WI-0034 is integrated at the review base and supplies the current-state trust contract; WI-0043 treats it as an invariant.
WI-0036 is integrated at the review base and supplies the private read-only projection; WI-0043 cannot weaken it.
WI-0040 is integrated at the review base and supplies usage/model evidence; WI-0043 may review its hierarchy but cannot invent missing Token data.
WI-0041 is integrated at the review base and supplies refresh coalescing; WI-0043 cannot change refresh behavior in the review slice.
WI-0042 is the verified private-LAN transport and provides review runtime evidence; WI-0043 does not reopen its authority boundary.
